title: Investor Inattention and the Market Impact of Summary Statistics
summary: Selected methods/Table2 discussion: Bloomberg surprise sign,10:05ET reversal through next-day close. Public forecast values differ across vendors.
about: Market response to the stale U.S. Leading Economic Index release.
findings: Authors report65bp gross per three-day ES event; their cost estimate yields6%annually. Not replicated.
mechanism: Investors may double-count already available component information, creating reversal.
